source: Master Edit Plan p.35-38 (SFX plan), offsets verified against loudness-envelope peaks (03_SFX/sfx_analysis.json)

rules.silence_by_design: No SFX in B4-B5, B9, the B16 glow line, or B17 before 'now?'.
rules.never: meme/comedy sounds, notification pings, success chimes, shutter on every photo, a whoosh on every cut or a pop on every caption.
rules.naming: Every SFX layer is named with its cue ID (e.g. 'S01 Cinematic Hit 1').

cues.plan: Peak at 0.33 s: start 10f before the slam. Trim to 1.5 s with a 12f fade.
Slice 0.5-1.3 s, starting on 'cops', 6f fade out, high-pass at 300 Hz.
Error sound starts 0.11 s into the file: start it 3f before the tear. Layer the glitch on the tear frame with +12 dB.
0.47 s long. Start on the first digit's move.
1.5 s, audible until 1.1 s. Start on 'dull', under the slow-motion drain. (Third to cut if busy.)
Peaks at 0.09/0.26/0.12 s: start each 3f, 8f and 4f before its stamp lands. Trim each to 0.8 s with an 8f fade. -12, -10, -8 dBFS (heavier each time).
2.1 s, ends abruptly at its peak. End lands on B8's first black frame (start about 63f earlier); from the second stamp into B8.
Both start instantly. Put both on the 'breaks' frame.
Start on 'fun', the same frame as the music drop and the flash. Trim at 2.5 s with a 20f fade.
Peak at 0.38 s: start 6f before the flip so the peak meets its midpoint.
1.4 s, ending in a hit at 1.14 s. Line that hit up with 'thirty' and the counter landing on 30.
Same file and placement as S04 (first to cut if busy).
1.3 s. Start with the first letter. If it doesn't sit with the letters, slice single keystrokes and place one every few letters.
Same file and slice as S02. Start on 'sirens'.
Only 0.2 s audible. Start 2f before the whip's midpoint. (Second to cut if busy.)
Peak at 0.96 s: start about 25f before the zoom's midpoint (0.96 s = 29f; peak alignment used, CONFLICTS C13).
1.1 s, ending at its peak. Place it so the end lands on the logo hit.
Same files as S08. On the logo hit; the ending echoes the break. -4 dBFS, the loudest moment.
